{{Quote|The location of the house is near Mos Eisley...mostly. I marked it on your map. Be careful. Them ranchers aren't the nicest people in the galaxy.|A pirate leader, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />}}
'''The Ranch''' was a farm located on the [[Great Mesra Plateau/Legends|Mesric Plateau]], on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
The ranch was located near the city of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. Although Tatooine had few plains and little vegetation for grazing, the building was established as a ranch and several animal species, including [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]] and [[Eopie/Legends|eopies]], were raised there.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" /> The ranch's location, on the edge of a cliff of the [[Great Mesra Plateau/Legends|Mesric Plateau]], created an impressive vista on the valley below.<ref name="SWG:PVT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Panoramic Vistas: Tatooine}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Some of our boys were looting a rancher's house when he walked in. He and his wife are holding our boys captive.|A pirate leader, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the ranch was inhabited by [[Roric Goldenfield|Roric]] and [[Helen Goldenfield]].<ref name="SWG:TMotH" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the ranchers were harassed by a group of local [[Sand slum pirates|pirates]]. Roric Goldenfield once managed to capture two of them, [[Arian Vh'ra]] and [[Itr Fairla]], while they were looting the ranch and hold them captive in the house. A [[Hero of Tatooine|spacer]] later met the pirate leader who tasked the adventurer to free the pirates. However, the spacer instead [[Quest of the Hero of Tatooine|helped]] Helen Goldenfield to prevent the pirates to escape while her husband was contacting [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] authorities.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Although Tatooine has few plains, and little vegetation for grazing; some locals make their living working a ranch. With the view from this patio, it's easy to see why.|In-game description of the Ranch|<ref name="SWG:PVT" />}}
The Ranch was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Ranch was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Hero of Tatooine|"Hero of Tatooine" questline]],<ref name="SWG" /> released with "[[W:c:swg:Publish 9 Notes for 29 June 04|Publish 9]]" on [[June 29]], [[2004]].<ref>{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?page=Recent%20Updates|text=Publish 9 Secrets of the Force}}</ref> The "Hero of Tatooine" questline was extensively revamped upon the introduction of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> but the "Honor" portion involving the ranch and the Goldenfield family in their ranch was not altered.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

[[File:Unknowndishswg.png|thumb|right|100px|An unknown dish located in the main house]]
The main house of the ranch could be considered a showcase for crafters. It contained many appearances of craftable items or reward items at the time of the launch of the game and also appearances of craftable items (or loot drops) that would appear later. The original appearance (later changed) of such items as [[Deuterium-pyro]], [[Durindfire (beverage)|Durindfire]] and [[Bivoli Tempari]] is found here as is the appearance of no-longer craftable items such as [[Aludium pu-36]], [[Corellian Fried Ice Cream]] (original chef-crafted version) and [[Tranna nougat cream]]. Several house items would never be available to players such as the green carpet, red carpet or an unidentified food item.

In the game, players could also complete a collection called "Panoramic Vistas" by visiting the ranch.<ref name="SWG:PVT" />
